title: Govern SharePoint agents
subtitle: Inventory agents, assign owners, review site risks, then retire stale agents.

steps.title: Inventory each agent and its sources
steps.evidence: Maintain one scheduled inventory containing each agent, its SharePoint site, knowledge sources and file count

steps.title: Review site access and labels
steps.evidence: Check sensitivity labels, external sharing, edit rights, external site ownership and broken inheritance

steps.title: Retire agents on stale sites
steps.evidence: Retire agents connected to stale sites, including sites nobody has opened in 90 days, after the owner decides whether to keep or archive them.
